text: Program DescriptionThe major of public service administration aims to train high-level public management professionals with wide caliber, compound and practical abilities for government departments, non-governmental organizations and personnel and administrative organizations of enterprises and institutions. The major of public administration aims to cultivate students' comprehensive analysis ability of current government affairs by comprehensively utilizing the knowledge of economics, politics, sociology and other disciplines.Main coursespublic administration, public policy, human resource management, management secretary, introduction to e-government, administration, public relations, etc.Duration4 years
